column10: "Calculation of the part-time gap between women and men. Your company has 1,000 employees, 600 women and 400 men. Among these women 20 are part-time and 5 among men. the calculation is: (20/600) = 3.3% of women working part-time. (5/400) = 1.25% of part-time men. That is to say: rate of part-time women - rate of part-time men = 3.3 - 1.25 = 2.05% of part-time difference between men and women. "
